events.title: Character Gender and Skin Tone Customization
events.summary: I’ve finished implementing gender and skin tone customization for Alia Domus!You’ll be able to choose between a male or female character and select from three skin tone options. This will help make your colonist feel more like your own as you explore the planet, complete quests, craft, and rebuild civilization.However, this feature will only be available in the final version. There isn’t enough time to properly integrate, test, and localize all the related dialogue and UI changes before the demo

events.title: I’m working on adding more character customization options to Alia Domus!
events.summary: The full game will include three skin tone options and the choice to play as a female character. I’m still working on the new sprites and animations, so these options won’t be available in the demo yet.It’s a substantial amount of work, but I’m excited to give players more ways to make their colonist feel like their own.

events.title: Demo Now Available!
events.summary: The demo for Alia Domus is now officially live on Steam.This build gives you an early look at the core material-era progression, survival mechanics, and world exploration. You can download it directly from the main store page using the "Download Demo" button.Since this is an early look at the game, feedback is welcome.
